name: Focus
author: local
description: Pomodoro timer with research-based focus sounds (white, pink and brown noise, binaural and isochronic beats) and selectable alert sounds. The panel is a client of the omarchy-focus engine (daemon/), which owns the timer, the audio and the settings.

barWidget.description: Pomodoro timer and focus sounds. Click for options, right-click to start or pause, middle-click to toggle the sound.
